title: Bedrock Knowledge Base with DynamoDB Integration
description: Build an intelligent agent that combines Amazon Bedrock Knowledge Base for RAG with DynamoDB for persistent data operations, creating a comprehensive information and transaction system

introBox.headline: How it works
text: Combines Bedrock Knowledge Base for RAG with DynamoDB for persistent storage
Implements CRUD operations through custom agent tools
Features document retrieval and semantic search capabilities
Provides context-aware responses using hybrid information sources
Handles AWS service integrations with comprehensive error handling
